basis: Owner instruction: adopt when practically useful; no fixed 90 percent gate
acceptance: Practical benefit when enabled, considering mission outcome, avoidable waiting, rework or intervention and total time/energy/cost
accepted_next_scope: Integrate as optional city pad-wait advisory and measure enabled/disabled mission effect
uncertainty_behavior: Defer to fresh observation and independent Rules; retain bounded hold/reobserve or mission-level escalation

deployment.integration_scope: Optional fixed delivery-pad camera CPU advisory through a deterministic Mission Assurance judge; not onboard or native VLA/ANWM joint flight

historical_protocol.status: retained as the original experiment record; its 90 percent condition no longer blocks adoption
